trace.msg: Let's look at this puzzle carefully. I'll only move when I can explain why.
Going left leaves no safe move afterwards; going up-left, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So the line goes down-left.
Going down-left would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going down-right would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes up-left.
Going up-left, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (-2,0); going up-right, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (-2,0). So the line goes left.
I can't rule out up-right or up-left yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up-right.
I can't rule out up-right or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up-right.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going up-left would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order); going up-right, the next 2 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at cell (-1,-2); going down-right would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So my guess (up-right from cell (-1,0)) was wrong, so the line must go right.
Number 4 is next and right here, so the line takes it.

Going right would leave number 5 unreachable without crossing a higher number; going left leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes up-left.

Going right would turn number 22 into a dead-end pocket with no way out. So the line goes up-right.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes down-right.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
